lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Next up, we have the much-anticipated rematch between Team Soda and Team Folkwang.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Begin!
*Beep*
The horn signaling the beginning of the game blares,
and both coins and eggs start falling from above us.

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: I'll take care of this side.

lines.speaker: alice_b
lines.text: All right!
Soda gazes upwards with a look of steely determination,
and starts rapidly filling her basket with coins.
*Clank* *Clank*

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Très agréable! Both teams are performing admirably.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: However, there is not much time left,

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: and more eggs will be falling as well, so be careful!
Both the coins and eggs start to fall with increasing speed.

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: *Huff...! Huff...!*

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: Gah!

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: Master, behind you!
*Crack*
An egg falls right behind, narrowly missing me.

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: Alice, your basket looks pretty heavy, are you okay?

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: We've got enough coins by now, so let's take it easy and focus on avoiding the eggs.

lines.speaker: alice_b
lines.text: Got it!

lines.speaker: folkwang_b
lines.text: Hmm.

lines.speaker: folkwang_b
lines.text: They seem in much better shape than they were before.

lines.speaker: folkwang_b
lines.text: Think we ought to kick things up a notch?

lines.speaker: novel
lines.text: Good idea.

lines.speaker: exia_c2
lines.text: I'll do my best to hide.

lines.speaker: folkwang_b
lines.text: *Huff...! Huff...!*

lines.speaker: folkwang_b
lines.text: Huh?!
*Crash*

lines.speaker: folkwang_b
lines.text: Dang it... my feet got sweaty again.

lines.speaker: folkwang_b
lines.text: My butt hurts...

lines.speaker: novel
lines.text: Are you okay?

lines.speaker: folkwang_b
lines.text: Yes, fortunately, I was able to save most of the coins.

lines.speaker: folkwang_b
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: Watch out! Another egg is coming!

lines.speaker: folkwang_b
lines.text: Soda isn't coming over to check on me this time around.

lines.speaker: folkwang_b
lines.text: Looks like the competition just got more cutthroat.

lines.speaker: folkwang_b
lines.text: We don't have time to mess around. Let's go get some more coins.

lines.speaker: novel
lines.text: Ah!

lines.speaker: novel
lines.text: Roger!

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Only five seconds remaining!

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Five! Four! Three! Two! One!
*Beep*

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: That's it!

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Everyone please wait here while we assess the results.

lines.speaker: alice_b
lines.text: Phew... that was exhausting.
My entire body feels like a limp noodle.

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: Phew...
Looks like the other team gathered quite a bit of coins as well.

lines.speaker: alice_b
lines.text: Yeah, you're right,

lines.speaker: alice_b
lines.text: but that's not important.

lines.speaker: alice_b
lines.text: What's important is that we did our best.

lines.speaker: alice_b
lines.text: How are you feeling, Green Bunny?

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: I think this is the first time that I really focused, concentrating with every fiber of my being.

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: I didn't waver, and I wasn't distracted by thinking about the other teams.

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: I can honestly say... that I did my best.
If it hadn't been for you, I would have gotten bonked by that egg and we would have been eliminated.

lines.speaker: alice_b
lines.text: And I would have gotten too excited and ended up dropping my basket while running.

lines.speaker: alice_b
lines.text: If we win this time, it's all thanks to you!

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: You mean...

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: I was able to help both of you?

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: Then...

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: Do you really think we can win?

lines.speaker: alice_b
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: alice_b
lines.text: You're sparkling again...

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: All right everyone!

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: We have finished tallying up all your coins.
Once Mustang begins speaking, everyone becomes silent.
We look towards Mustang with nervous anticipation.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: It took two showdowns to determine the winner, but at long last, we have un résultat décisif.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: And the winner is...

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: none other than...

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Team Soda!

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: Huh...?

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: Wow!!

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: W-we won?!

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: Did you hear that, you guys? They said we won!

lines.speaker: alice_b
lines.text: Woohoo!

lines.speaker: alice_b
lines.text: We won!
Hooray!

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Both teams delivered remarkable performances,

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: but unfortunately for Team Folkwang, this is the end of the line.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: And with that, our third game has come to a close.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: As always, the éliminée team may choose to stay and spectate or leave the area.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: With tomorrow's game, we will officially be entering the semi-finals.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Team Soda and Team Volume, make sure you're in fighting shape!

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Until next time, everyone, have fun and enjoy yourselves!
*Badump badump badump*

lines.speaker: alice_b
lines.text: Oh boy, I'm drenched in sweat!
Me too. We should get some rest.

lines.speaker: folkwang_b
lines.text: Congratulations, you guys.

lines.speaker: folkwang_b
lines.text: Seeing how much the three of you are sweating makes me feel less bummed about losing.

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: Oh, Folkwang!

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: Are you okay? I saw you take another tumble earlier.

lines.speaker: folkwang_b
lines.text: I'm fine.

lines.speaker: folkwang_b
lines.text: I think I didn't have as much focus as I should have because I didn't take my supplements.

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: Oh... I see.

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: I wanted to go and help you, but... well, you know.

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: Sorry.

lines.speaker: folkwang_b
lines.text: What are you apologizing for?

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: Huh...?

lines.speaker: folkwang_b
lines.text: We're on opposing teams, after all. And it was just a little fall.

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: But I could have helped you... Instead, I pretended not to notice.

lines.speaker: folkwang_b
lines.text: That's the nature of the game.

lines.speaker: folkwang_b
lines.text: You have nothing to apologize for.

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: O-okay...

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: Everyone seems to be saying the same thing...

lines.speaker: folkwang_b
lines.text: Dang, it feels like a thousand degrees in here.

lines.speaker: folkwang_b
lines.text: It's too bad that our best wasn't good enough,

lines.speaker: folkwang_b
lines.text: but at least we had fun.
Folkwang extends her hand to Soda.

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: Wha...?

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: Do you want to shake my hand?

lines.speaker: folkwang_b
lines.text: Sure, why not?

lines.speaker: folkwang_b
lines.text: You kicked butt out there and collected the most coins.

lines.speaker: folkwang_b
lines.text: You've got a keen eye, and you're a natural athlete.

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: M-Me?

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: Uh...

lines.speaker: folkwang_b
lines.text: Do you not want to shake my hand because my palms are sweaty?

lines.speaker: folkwang_b
lines.text: This is starting to get a bit awkward, you know.

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: Oh, no!

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: It's not that!

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: I'd be honored to shake your hand!
Soda hurriedly shakes Folkwang's hand.

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: But...

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: Can I ask you a question?

lines.speaker: folkwang_b
lines.text: Of course,

lines.speaker: folkwang_b
lines.text: but could you maybe let go of my hand first? I'm sweating like crazy over here.

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: Oh, sure.

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: Anyway...

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: I noticed that Exia wasn't really participating in the game.

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: Does that not bother you two?

lines.speaker: novel
lines.text: Hmm?

lines.speaker: novel
lines.text: I'm afraid there's an inaccuracy in that statement.

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: novel
lines.text: It might look like she's just fooling around,

lines.speaker: novel
lines.text: but Exia was definitely playing right along with us.

lines.speaker: exia_c2
lines.text: Hey, ease up with the wording, will ya?

lines.speaker: exia_c2
lines.text: No one said anything about fooling around...

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: You mean she participated with you guys?

lines.speaker: folkwang_b
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: folkwang_b
lines.text: Exia's mobility isn't the best,

lines.speaker: folkwang_b
lines.text: so if she had attempted to stumble around out in the open collecting coins, she would have gotten plastered with an egg and gotten us eliminated.

lines.speaker: folkwang_b
lines.text: Therefore, we had her hang out in safe spots where she would be safe from getting hit.

lines.speaker: exia_c2
lines.text: In other words,

lines.speaker: exia_c2
lines.text: I contributed in my own unique fashion.

lines.speaker: exia_c2
lines.text: There would have been no point for me to have been running around out there.

lines.speaker: exia_c2
lines.text: You've got to play smarter, not harder.

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: Ah...

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: folkwang_b
lines.text: Anyway, I'm burning up in here. Gonna go get some rest.

lines.speaker: folkwang_b
lines.text: Since we're no longer in the game, I'll be in your corner cheering you on.

lines.speaker: exia_c2
lines.text: Same here. Anyway, the new game I've been playing probably has new updates, so I'm gonna go see if I can get on the leaderboards.

lines.speaker: novel
lines.text: I'm going to go snooping around for new cases. I can feel one brewing!
After Folkwang, Exia, and Novel disperse,
Alice, Soda, and I stand around somewhat awkwardly for a moment.
... Should we get something to drink?

lines.speaker: alice_b
lines.text: Sounds good!

lines.speaker: alice_b
lines.text: Let's go!

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: All right!
